subject: Rstudio: ctrl+2 "Move Focus to Console" from "viewer" not working

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: Rstudio: ctrl+2 "Move Focus to Console" from "viewer" not working
parts:
Hello,

This question is about using Rstudio for Shiny development, so is at least peripherally related.

I use a 3rd party editor to work on shiny apps (sublime text). I run my shiny apps using runApp(launch.browser = rstudio::viewer). It all works great except it is persistent annoyance when I'm testing/debuging. I iterate these steps many many times:
  1. text editor
  2. alt+tab to rstudio
  3. click in console window
  4. hit up arrow and return (to recall the runApp(launch.browser=rstudio::viewer) command)
  5. try interface in the viewer
  6. alt+tab back to editor
  7. edit file and repeat
That "click in console window" step is geting old. I would rather do "ctrl+2" but doesn't seem to work with viewer in rstudio. It must be that he viewer has it's own short cut keys that override rstudio's. 

Is it possible to override or delete the viewer shortcuts? or is this some other issue.

Jonathan
